headline: Sensex and Nifty tumble amid rising bond yields; BSE shares rise ahead of Nifty 50 entry

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: India's 10-year bond yield hit a two-year high, putting pressure on equity markets
Nifty Bank crashed 1,800 points over two days, slipping below the 54,000 mark
Global concerns regarding inflation and multi-decade high Japanese bond yields
Significant investor wealth erosion with losses totaling nearly Rs 6 lakh crore in a single session
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty experienced sharp declines, though the Sensex recovered nearly 600 points from its daily low
BSE shares rose 2% in anticipation of the stock's inclusion in the Nifty 50 index
Adani Airport Holdings successfully raised $120 million through a local bond issue
Pharma and Metal sectors showed resilience, trading in the green despite the broader market sell-off
summary: The Indian stock market faced a volatile session with the Sensex and Nifty tumbling due to rising bond yields and a banking sector crash. While broader indices struggled, BSE shares gained ahead of their Nifty 50 entry and Adani Airport Holdings raised fresh capital. Despite heavy investor losses, pharma and metal stocks provided some support as the market attempted a recovery from its lows.
